note: Owner-approved user-facing display names for the 38 promoted railway lines (dataset OSM-HU-RAIL-VERIFIED-2026-09-23). Approval does not assert current passenger service, complete settlement coverage, reproduction of legal infrastructure endpoints, or a single operator along the full line - see docs/RAILWAY_LINE_DISPLAY_NAME_AND_DETAIL_REVIEW.md and the owner's approval message for the exact disclaimer. Applied by scripts/promote-osm-railway-reference.py via --display-name-decisions; a line with no entry here, or an entry with humanApproved != true, keeps the safe '<code>. számú vasútvonal' placeholder.

decisions.evidence: Own dataset verifies 1 settlement (Tata), an intermediate stop; the dedicated article confirms this line's own opening photo caption 'Személyvonat Tata közelében'. Legal endpoint is Budapest-Keleti–Rusovce (SK, cross-border); domestic short name uses Hegyeshalom (last major Hungarian town before the border) with Győr added as a recognisable intermediate hub, not itself evidenced as a verified settlement in this dataset.

Own dataset verifies 1 settlement (Székesfehérvár), the shared endpoint of both the legal endpoint name (Lovasberény–Székesfehérvár) and the article's own name (Bicske–Székesfehérvár); owner chose the article's common name. The dedicated article's own infobox lists a max speed of '20/0 km/h' and an 'official walkability limit' marker, suggesting the line may not currently carry regular passenger service along its full length - owner approval explicitly does not assert current service.
